prompt: Pearl bakes a giant birthday cake
title: Giant Birthday Cake
irony: Pearl says yes to each extra flavor to please the party, so the giant cake pleases nobody until she says no to more and cuts it small.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Sun lights the big house kitchen where Pearl lifts a giant pink cake with six candles.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Teddy asks for dinosaur candles, Benny asks for rainbow frosting, and Pearl says yes to each new wish.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Constance cites rules, Pearl stacks one more tall layer, and the giant cake starts to wobble.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: Friends sing and clap around the giant cake and chant its name with joy.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Teddy corrects the candle count with dinosaur facts while Benny piles sprinkles where the frosting slides.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: The crew carries the wobbly cake to the street where a frosting blob lands on Teddy's nose.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: Neighbors gather in the street and sing the cake chant louder around the wobbly tower.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Pearl admits she says yes to each wish because she fears an empty plate.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Pearl decides to say no to more layers while Constance lifts a plate and Benny smiles.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Pearl sings the turned line and serves small slices from the giant tower.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Friends taste small slices in the street and laugh with Pearl under sunny skies.
